title: Mockery
html_source:
Mockery is one of the principal strains of Buck’s character. He begins by mocking religion and proceeds to mock both Stephen and his “absurd name” Dedalus.
This identifies Buck with the suitors in the “Odyssey”. They frequently mock Telemachus for his impotence in the face of their occupancy of his palace and their consumption of his food and drink. Antinous is the most conspicuous and offensive of these.
